text: Ladies and gentlemen, give it up for the pressure fighter who owns the whole building! One point seven nine meters, charcoal rash guard, white hand wraps and a face built from a photo. All thirty clips check out: the throws, the foot pitch refit and the restored timing. The smoothed clothing earns a point too. Realism climbs from thirty five to thirty seven! But those jagged hems, that waist gap and that painted-on hair are still holding the face back. Approved! Put your hands together for the Landlord of the Ring, THE OWNER!
